findings.text:
Relaxed check is safe: observation.draft is the 'after' native read, and observe() already throws unless before.draft == after.draft, so both native reads agree on empty. Empty is strict: ClaudeNativeDraft.read yields '' only for raw=='
' with a single is-empty/is-editor-empty child, or a childless field with raw==''. Whitespace-only text (' ', '

') is non-empty and still requires exact driver match; ambiguous rich/paragraph states throw. Exactly-one-field and frame equality are retained. Residual: driver value is now wholly ignored when native is empty (previously only nil/'
' accepted), but a draft typed inside the narrow driver-read window is caught by the bracketing native reads, and typing paths re-verify native draft == step.before/after and re-read native before input.

'Main' web area = outermost AXWebArea (recursion stops at the first AXWebArea on each branch, does not descend into it). A nested card cannot be counted since its ancestor web area is returned instead; two separate top-level web areas still yield count 2 and throw .incomplete. Behavior note: composers/transcripts are still gathered from all descendants (including cards), so a composer or 'Chat messages' group inside a card fails safe (count !=1 -> incomplete). Weakness only in theory: if Muse ever wrapped the real chat inside a different outer AXWebArea, the outer one would be chosen, but the existing URL allowlist (muse.ai/new side chat/thread) would then reject it.

Tests cover placeholder accepted on empty native (no type_text/click calls) and a non-empty native draft with a placeholder-valued driver still blocked. Not covered: whitespace-only native draft with a mismatching driver value, and placeholder on the 'after'-read path where native is empty but expected text is not (guarded separately by typed.draft == step.after). Minor test helper added: driverPlaceholder is a mutable instance var on the XCTestCase; fine.

Muse test covers nested card web area (about:srcdoc) inside the chat page parsing OK with merged card text, and a sibling second web area throwing. Not covered: nested card containing its own composer or Chat messages group.

notes: No path found where a non-empty user draft could be overwritten or misread under the relaxed Claude check. Branch history contains the 0.11.1 release-notes add and its revert; net diff touches only the 4 stated files. Not run: no Swift toolchain.
tests: Two new Claude tests (placeholder accepted for empty native editor; placeholder does not hide a non-empty native draft) and one new Muse test (nested card web area ignored; sibling web area throws). Reviewed by reading only; I did not run them.
